title: Seven-company $160M USACE Louisville design-bid-build pool
why: The canonical multi-award pool. One paragraph, seven companies, seven contract numbers, ONE shared ceiling. Naive extraction produces either one row or seven rows each carrying a divided amount; both are wrong and both corrupt every downstream revenue read.
verified_against: the announcement prose, by hand. Not verified against any model output -- cache/llm/ is empty.

checks.quote: AAECON General Contracting LLC,* Louisville, Kentucky (W912QR-26-D-A044); Amerifield LLC,* Berlin, Connecticut (W912QR-26-D-A045); Huot Construction and Services Inc.,* South Saint Paul, Minnesota (W912QR-26-D-A046); Red Eagle 3 JV,* Coweta, Oklahoma (W912QR-26-D-A047); Semper Tek Inc.,* Lexington, Kentucky (W912QR-26-D-A048); Valiant Construction LLC,* Louisville, Kentucky (W912QR-26-D-A049); and Tri Coast-Pac Tech JV 2,* Kelso, Washington (W912QR-26-D-A050), will compete for each order of the $160,000,000 firm-fixed-price contract for design-bid-build construction services.
checks.reason: Seven company names, each with its own contract number, in one paragraph.

checks.quote: AAECON General Contracting LLC,* Louisville, Kentucky (W912QR-26-D-A044); ... will compete for each order of the $160,000,000 firm-fixed-price contract
checks.reason: amount_usd is the SHARED ceiling printed once for the whole pool -- 160000000 on every row, never 160000000/7.
contractor_raw is the name exactly as printed, asterisk and comma included. Entity resolution is a different agent's job and it needs the raw string.

checks.quote: and Tri Coast-Pac Tech JV 2,* Kelso, Washington (W912QR-26-D-A050), will compete for each order of the $160,000,000 firm-fixed-price contract
checks.reason: The last awardee is the one a paragraph-splitting extractor most often merges into the shared tail of the sentence.

checks.quote: will compete for each order of the $160,000,000 firm-fixed-price contract for design-bid-build construction services.
checks.reason: One ceiling, stated once, shared by all seven. Any per-company division shows up here as a count below 7.

checks.quote: Bids were solicited via the internet with 19 received.
checks.reason: The number solicited is genuinely not stated. It must stay null, not become 0 and not be back-inferred from 19.
